title: NHL Powerplay '96
overview:
Play for Real

Total Control
The only game with a full selection of offensive and defensive plays.
Other games - one non-adjustable style

Total Challenge
The only game with advanced artificial intelligence, so players strategize and react true-to-life.
Other games - predictable, canned, and way too easy

Total Reality
The only game with a true 3-D environment and motion-captured players wearing real NHL uniforms.
Other games - fake-looking artist renderings

Total World
The only game with a World Tournament Event plus NHL players, teams and stats.
Other games - no ready-to-play international competition

This is hockey that'll knock your skates off, rattle your teeth and send every other game you've played limping off to the showers.

Run the trap, pinch the defense, dump and chase - this is the only game that gives you the whole arsenal of offensive and defensive plays. And you're going to need it against players who skate, deke and check just like the pros.

But in case advanced artificial intelligence, superior gameplay and killer control aren't enough for you, there's the most lifelike graphics you've ever seen.

In fact, only one game is more realistic than NHL Powerplay '96, and for that one you need padding.
